name: Front/Back Face Flagging
definition: Assigns a boolean 'front' flag to voxels intersected by a triangle, indicating whether the triangle is front-facing relative to a specific filling direction (used to distinguish interior from exterior during filling).
summary: Front/Back Face Flagging assigns orientation flags to voxels intersected by mesh surfaces, distinguishing front-facing from back-facing triangles relative to a filling direction to resolve interior-exterior ambiguity.
